shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个贴有危险象形图标签的试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a closed reagent bottle with a blank label showing GHS hazard pictograms in red diamonds.
shots.narration: 这一课讲化学品的危害告知。
overlay: 化学品危害告知：一书一签

shots.scene: 一本空白说明书和一张空白标签并排
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety data sheet booklet and a blank chemical label with red diamond pictograms side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 一书一签：安全技术说明书和安全标签。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一个瓶子，看着标签上的菱形图案发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a reagent bottle and stares blankly at the red diamond pictograms on its label.
shots.narration: 阿杰看着标签上的红菱形，一头雾水。

shots.scene: 阿杰把标签转到背面，直接准备倒液体
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns the label away and gets ready to pour without reading it.
shots.narration: 他干脆不看了，打算直接用。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指着标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and taps the label with her finger.
shots.narration: 小研说：危险信息都写在这儿呢。

shots.section_title: 安全意识，从危害告知开始
shots.scene: 两个人之间有一个对话气泡，里面是警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Two simple person icons with a speech bubble between them containing a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 安全意识，从把危害讲清楚开始。
overlay: 安全意识，从危害告知开始

shots.section_title: 接触的人都要知道三件事
shots.scene: 欣欣伸出三根手指，旁边浮现三张卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three fingers beside three floating blank cards.
shots.narration: 凡是可能接触的人，都要知道三件事。
overlay: 接触的人都要知道三件事

shots.section_title: 接触的人都要知道三件事
shots.scene: 清洁工、学生、老师的剪影都指向同一个试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Simple silhouettes of a cleaner, a student and a teacher all looking at the same labeled reagent bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 做实验的、打扫的、来帮忙的，都算。

shots.section_title: 生产和进口单位：先评估危害
shots.scene: 工厂图标旁有放大镜在检查化学品
shots.prompt_en: A factory icon with a magnifying glass examining a chemical drum. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品的生产和进口单位，
overlay: 生产和进口单位：先评估危害

shots.section_title: 生产和进口单位：先评估危害
shots.scene: 化学品桶上逐一出现危险分类的图标
shots.prompt_en: A chemical drum with hazard class icons appearing one by one beside it: a flame, a skull and a corroded hand. No people.
shots.narration: 要先评估化学品有哪些危害。

shots.section_title: 生产和进口单位：配齐一书一签
shots.scene: 工厂图标送出一本说明书和一张标签，箭头指向实验室
shots.prompt_en: A factory icon sending a blank data sheet booklet and a blank label along an arrow to a lab building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 再配齐安全标签和安全技术说明书，
overlay: 生产和进口单位：配齐一书一签

shots.section_title: 生产和进口单位：配齐一书一签
shots.scene: 试剂瓶随说明书一起到达实验室
shots.prompt_en: A delivered reagent box opened on a bench, a bottle with a pictogram label and a blank booklet inside. No people.
shots.narration: 把危害信息传给下游的使用者。

shots.section_title: 使用单位：标签和说明书交到手
shots.scene: 老周把说明书放进实验室文件架
shots.prompt_en: The older man places a blank safety data sheet booklet into a binder on the lab shelf.
shots.narration: 使用化学品的单位和实验室，
overlay: 使用单位：标签和说明书交到手

shots.section_title: 使用单位：标签和说明书交到手
shots.scene: 每个试剂瓶标签完好，旁边对应一份说明书
shots.prompt_en: A row of reagent bottles with intact pictogram labels, each matched to a blank booklet behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 要保证标签完好、说明书随手可得。

shots.scene: 王老师在培训室给学生上课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a group of students in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 还要组织培训，教会大家正确操作。
overlay: 使用单位：组织培训

shots.section_title: 培训讲清本岗位危害和防护
shots.scene: 王老师指着实验室平面图上的危险区域
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a simple lab floor map with hazard icons marking certain benches.
shots.narration: 培训要讲清本岗位有哪些危害，
overlay: 培训讲清本岗位危害和防护

shots.section_title: 培训讲清本岗位危害和防护
shots.scene: 护目镜、手套、通风柜三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: safety goggles, protective gloves and a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 以及自己该采取哪些防护措施。

shots.section_title: 术语：需要启动监测的浓度
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个空白的浓度表前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a blank chart with a rising concentration curve.
shots.narration: 说明书里常见几个接触限值的术语。
overlay: 术语：需要启动监测的浓度

shots.section_title: 术语：需要启动监测的浓度
shots.scene: 浓度曲线越过一条虚线，出现监测仪和体检图标
shots.prompt_en: A concentration curve crossing a dashed line, triggering a gas monitor icon and a medical checkup icon. No people.
shots.narration: 浓度高到一定程度，就要监测和体检。

shots.section_title: 术语：任何时候都不能超的上限
shots.scene: 一条粗红线，曲线碰到就被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A thick red horizontal line at the top of a chart; a curve touching it is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 最高容许浓度：任何时候都不能超过。
overlay: 术语：任何时候都不能超的上限

shots.scene: 测量仪读数旁有正负号的误差范围
shots.prompt_en: A blank measuring instrument display with a reading bar and a plus-minus range bracket around it. No people.
shots.narration: 测量结果有误差，判断时要留余量。
overlay: 术语：测量有误差

shots.scene: 短时间内曲线出现尖峰，旁边有小秒表
shots.prompt_en: A chart with a short sharp peak in the curve and a small stopwatch icon above the peak. No people.
shots.narration: 短时间接触容许浓度，管短时高峰。
overlay: 术语：短时间接触限值

shots.scene: 一整天的曲线被拉平成一条平均线
shots.prompt_en: A full-day wavy curve with a flat average line drawn through it and a sun-to-moon workday icon. No people.
shots.narration: 时间加权平均，看整个工作日的平均。
overlay: 术语：时间加权平均

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本空白标准
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank standards booklet.
shots.narration: 具体限值，以国家标准现行文本为准。

shots.section_title: 可燃与易燃，行业标准有差别
shots.scene: 两个瓶子，一个标着小火苗，一个标着大火苗
shots.prompt_en: Two closed bottles side by side, one with a small flame icon and one with a big flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃液体和易燃液体，常被放在一起讲。
overlay: 可燃与易燃，行业标准有差别

shots.section_title: 可燃与易燃，行业标准有差别
shots.scene: 实验室、工地、仓库三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a laboratory, a construction site and a warehouse. No people.
shots.narration: 不同行业的标准，可能并不一样。

shots.section_title: 按闪点区分可燃与易燃
shots.scene: 温度计和小火苗，火苗在低温处就出现
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon with a small flame appearing at a low mark next to a flask icon. No people.
shots.narration: 区分它们，主要看闪点高低。
overlay: 按闪点区分可燃与易燃

shots.section_title: 按闪点区分可燃与易燃
shots.scene: 低闪点的瓶子被放进易燃品柜
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with a low thermometer icon placed into a yellow flammable storage cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 闪点越低，越容易着火，越要小心。

shots.section_title: 按闪点区分可燃与易燃
shots.scene: 小研对照说明书查看分类
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads the classification section of a blank safety data sheet.
shots.narration: 怎么分类，查说明书和国家标准。

shots.scene: 一把大伞下罩着很多危险图标
shots.prompt_en: A big umbrella icon covering many small hazard icons underneath. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃常被当成笼统说法，
overlay: “易燃”是个笼统说法

shots.scene: 小研指着说明书里具体的分类条目
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a specific line in a blank safety data sheet next to a flame pictogram.
shots.narration: 具体是哪一类、多危险，要看说明书。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁排开九个危险象形图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside nine GHS hazard pictograms in red diamonds arranged in a grid.
shots.narration: 标签上的红菱形，叫危险象形图。
overlay: 认识象形图和信号词

shots.scene: 火焰、骷髅、腐蚀三个象形图放大
shots.prompt_en: Three large GHS pictograms in red diamonds: a flame, a skull and crossbones, and a corrosion pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 火焰易燃，骷髅剧毒，腐蚀伤皮肤。

shots.scene: 两个空白词条，一个红色加粗，一个橙色
shots.prompt_en: Two blank word boxes on a label, one bold red box and one orange box. No people.
shots.narration: 信号词“危险”比“警告”更严重。

shots.scene: 一张大标签被分成几个区域
shots.prompt_en: A large blank chemical label divided into several empty zones with red diamond pictograms in one corner. No people.
shots.narration: 安全标签上有名称、象形图、信号词，
overlay: 安全标签上有什么

shots.scene: 标签上另外几块区域高亮
shots.prompt_en: Other zones of the blank label highlighted: a hazard statement area, a precaution area and a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还有危险说明、防范说明和应急电话。

shots.section_title: 安全技术说明书怎么查
shots.scene: 说明书打开，分成十六格
shots.prompt_en: An open blank safety data sheet booklet with sixteen empty numbered boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 安全技术说明书一共十六个部分。
overlay: 安全技术说明书怎么查

shots.section_title: 安全技术说明书怎么查
shots.scene: 急救、泄漏、储存、防护几个格子高亮
shots.prompt_en: Some boxes of the booklet highlighted with icons: a first aid cross, a spill, a cabinet and a goggles icon. No people.
shots.narration: 急救、泄漏、储存、防护，用前先看。

shots.scene: 阿杰把试剂分装到小瓶里
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in goggles and gloves pours a small amount of liquid from a big labeled bottle into a small empty bottle.
shots.narration: 从大瓶分装到小瓶，
overlay: 分装、自配，也要贴签

shots.scene: 小瓶上贴好新标签，无标签的瓶子被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A small bottle with a new blank label and a red diamond pictogram gets a green check; an unlabeled bottle beside it is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 也要贴上名称、浓度、危险性和日期。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现说明书和标签
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a floating blank data sheet booklet and a blank pictogram label.
shots.narration: 一书一签，危害信息层层传到你手上。
overlay: 小结

shots.scene: 工厂、实验室、学生三个图标串成链
shots.prompt_en: Three icons linked in a chain: a factory, a lab building and a student with goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 评估、告知、培训，一环都不能少。

shots.scene: 象形图、信号词、说明书三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a red diamond pictogram, a bold word box and an open booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 看懂象形图，分清信号词，用前查说明。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起贴好标签的瓶子，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a properly labeled bottle and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 先看标签再动手，下次见！
